name: Perona
title: Steal their will to fight with rest effects in this removal deck!
desc:
Your Leader's ability to rest a low cost Character every turn makes it easy to get control of the
board in the early game.

Combining black cost-reducing cards with green cards able to K.O. rested Characters allows you to
remove Characters with exceptional efficiency.

After taking the board, use your advantage to press your opponent with high-cost Characters.

cards.name: Perona
cards.text:
[Activate: Main] [Once Per Turn] Choose one:
• Rest up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost of 4 or less.
• Give up to 1 of your opponent's Characters −1 cost during this turn.
